thread.title: Stock Market On Fire As Dow Soars 1,086 Points, But Will Rally Last? | Investor's Business Daily

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Stock Market On Fire As Dow Soars 1,086 Points, But Will Rally Last? | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Christmas came late on Wall Street as the stock market stormed higher to boost the Dow Jones industrial average, S&P 500 and Nasdaq to 5% or bigger leaps.
X Surging tech stocks boosted the Nasdaq to a 5.8% vault, while the S&P 500 and Dow jumped 5% each. Small caps took part in the big advance with the Russell 2000 also rallying 5%. Volume was mixed, running higher on the Nasdaq and slightly lower on the NYSE, according to preliminary data.
All 30 component stocks in the Dow Jones industrial average soared Wednesday, led by 7% moves from Nike ( NKE ) and Apple ( AAPL ). Other blue chips scoring gains of 6% or more included Microsoft ( MSFT ), Boeing ( BA ), Visa ( V ) and Home Depot ( HD ).
Apple snapped a four-session slide with its 7% bounce in heavy trade. Shares remain 19% below the 200-day moving average and 32% off an Oct. 3 peak. It will take some time before a new potential buy opportunity emerges. Apple's midrange iPhone XR is attracting more former Android users thus far than the iPhone X did last year, according to a new survey .
Apple is the subject of many analysts' bold predictions for 2019 — including a tie-up with or buy of Tesla ( TSLA ) or Sony 's ( SNE ) Sony Pictures movie studio.
Microsoft rose 6.8%, also halting a four-session decline. It's now the biggest stock by market cap. Shares had been forming a flat base before the latest downturn. Microsoft is 13% off its Oct. 3 high.
Retailers Rally In Stock Market Today Retail, apparel makers and car manufacturers led the upside among sector gainers in the stock market today. Internet retail, the top group, surged more than 8%. Amazon.com ( AMZN ), Shutterfly ( SFLY ), Etsy ( ETSY ) and MercadoLibre ( MELI ), popped more than 8% apiece.
Amazon announced a record-breaking holiday season and said "tens of millions" signed up for its Amazon Prime membership program. A Cowen analyst named the online retail giant his "best idea" for 2019 . Other analysts predict Amazon will buy Target ( TGT ), Kohl's ( KSS ) or Snapchat maker Snap ( SNAP ).
It wasn't just Amazon that saw robust sales. Holiday retail sales topped $850 billion as they grew at their fastest pace in six years , according to MasterCard SpendingPulse data. Apparel sales were particularly strong.

Software stocks continued their recent strength in the IBD 50. RingCentral ( RNG ) surged 11%. Atlassian ( TEAM ) soared 8% while Adobe ( ADBE ), Veeva Systems ( VEEV ) and Five9 ( FIVN ) also rose at least 8% each.
The lone IBD 50 decliner was Kirkland Lake Gold ( KL ), down 1.1%. The Canadian gold miner reversed lower after hitting a new record high. The Innovator IBD 50 ETF ( FFTY ) rallied 6.2%.
